## Other sources mined

- README of every repo-search hit that did not name a status bar in its name or description (about 21,000 repos, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com), filtered by whether the README's opening is about a status line, HUD, powerline, band above or under the prompt, or tmux status, then read by hand.
- `karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods` `data/mods.json` (6,750 catalogued mods): every mod that draws above the prompt, in the prompt footer, or in a pane and describes usage, context, cost, cache, model, effort or a reacting pet, read by hand.
- Link lists in the READMEs of `ugglr/crabby-claude-code-mods`, `omarcevi/claudemods`, `karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods`, `testy-cool/awesome-claude-code-mods`, `lycfyi/awesome-claude-code-mods`, `SeongGwangJu/k-mods`, `hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code` and `zhuyansen/awesome-claude-code-hooks`, each linked repo checked with `gh api repos/<name>`.
- Auto-generated mirrors (`costrict-plugins-repo/*`, `iflow-mcp/*`) and Homebrew/Scoop taps were traced to their original repos, which are listed in place of the mirror.

Excluded by rule: GUI apps (menu bar, tray, notch, desktop widgets, VS Code or JetBrains panels, hardware displays), tools for other agents only (Codex, pi, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kimi), kits and dotfiles where the statusline is a minor file, unmodified forks, and repos that GitHub now returns 404 for.
